What Happened

  • The party continued through Level 2 of the Highreach Mines
  • Julie scouted ahead and solved a puzzle door
  • Fought through a goblin-held room, then used Daern's Instant Fortress to long rest inside the mines
  • During the rest, Julie discovered she was cursed — she could not heal naturally

Key Takeaways

  • The Instant Fortress is a powerful tactical asset — the party can rest safely anywhere
  • Julie needs to find a way to remove her curse before it gets her killed
